description:
Reconstruye JSON anidado a partir de claves con puntos; los índices numéricos crean arreglos. Cuándo: hay que transformar, comparar o revisar con exactitud datos estructurados (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arreglos). No para: aplanar objetos y arreglos anidados en un nivel con claves con puntos (json-flatten-paths). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Rebuilds nested JSON from flat dotted keys; numeric segments and [n] become array indices (max 10,000) unless arrays is false. Conflicting keys and __proto__/constructor/prototype segments are rejected. When: structured data (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arrays) has to be transformed, compared or checked exactly. Not for: flattening nested objects/arrays into one level with dotted keys (json-flatten-paths). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Rebuilds nested JSON from flat dotted keys; numeric segments and [n] become array indices (max 10,000) unless arrays is false. Conflicting keys and __proto__/constructor/prototype segments are rejected. When: structured data (JSON, CSV, YAML, XML, arrays) has to be transformed, compared or checked exactly. Not for: flattening nested objects/arrays into one level with dotted keys (json-flatten-paths). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

arrays.description: Numeric keys create arrays (boolean; optional; default true).

separator.description: Key separator (string; optional; default "."; at least 1 chars; up to 4 chars).

name: json-unflatten
title: Reconstruir JSON aplanado
